example.introduction: The operator reports that its KServe serving capability is unavailable.

example.title: Serving capability unavailable

narrative: Inspect `status.failure` on a pending serving revision. When `status.failure.code` is `ExecutionPodUnschedulable`, the Pod is waiting for an eligible node. Compare the serving template in `spec.placementTemplateRef` and the Pod's resource requests with node labels, taints, affinity rules and available capacity. After readiness, compare the loaded model and graph digests with the requested inputs.
